cases.name: Shawntae Lynn Smith Brown
cases.about:
Sheila Smith is heartbroken over the brutal death of her older sister, Shawntae Brown. “My sister meant the world to me, and I didn’t know any of this was even going on,” Smith said. “Beautiful soul. You know, that was my older sister, but I’m the protector.”

https://www.koco.com/article/spencer-family-speaks-out-after-woman-found-beaten-to-death-in-suspected-domestic-violence/34259188
cases.narrative:
When police arrived, they discovered she had been deceased for several hours. Police say she was beaten with the gun so severely that parts of it were shattered and it was caked in hair and blood. Police say her body was covered in bruises and cuts consistent with a severe beating.

Their children were inside the home at the time of the attack. Police say one of the children told them they watched their father beat their mother with a handgun, a belt, a shoe and a flagpole. They also said their father forced them to clean up the crime afterwards.

https://kfor.com/news/local/husband-arrested-in-murder-of-spencer-mother-of-3-tells-police-he-went-too-far/
